text:
Sampled ranking can reverse model comparisons relative to full-catalog ranking, even in expectation; training-pair separation therefore cannot establish recommendation quality. [Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) provide the foundational result. Practical implication: retain the pinned 99-negative validation evaluator and macro HR@10 selection rule. For diagnostics only, reuse several independently seeded, fixed candidate panels across checkpoints; report per-category support, paired changes, and panel variability. These panels measure sampling sensitivity, not full-catalog equivalence.

[Recommender metamorphic testing research (2024)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0950584924000156) evaluates six relations across three open-source systems and reports failure-detection capability. Proposed application, rather than a literature-validated SASRec recipe: inject constant scores, duplicated embeddings, corrupted item routing, and shuffled histories into disposable model copies; verify targeted probes respond. Multiplying all candidate scores by the same positive constant must preserve rankings, subject to ties and numerical precision. Raw margins and sigmoid-based separation can change under this transformation, so report them separately from ranking diagnostics.

[Guo et al., ICML 2024](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v235/guo24e.html) identify embedding collapse as occupation of a low-dimensional subspace; a [2026 preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23191) studies effective-rank dynamics in RankMixer. Neither establishes a universal SASRec failure threshold. Track singular-value entropy effective rank, norms, and score dispersion with explicit definitions, excluding padding; flag undefined zero-spectrum cases. Compare diagnostic changes with already available pinned validation outcomes across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl, reporting uncertainty and avoiding causal claims. Keep diagnostic rankings out of model selection; twenty simulator users provide limited descriptive support.
